_notes.vin_structure: 17 chars: pos1-3=WMI, pos4-8=VDS, pos9=check_digit, pos10=model_year, pos11=plant, pos12-17=serial
_notes.vds_market_split: CRITICAL — Audi uses TWO different VDS schemas depending on market. European-format VINs (most GCC vehicles): pos4-6 = 'ZZZ' filler, pos7 = model_line_code, pos8 = engine_code, pos9 = NOT check digit (often Z or 0). US-format VINs: pos4=model_series, pos5=engine, pos6=restraint, pos7=body_style, pos8=drive/transmission, pos9=NHTSA check digit.
_notes.gcc_note: Most UAE/GCC Audi vehicles are European-format (WAU/WA1 WMI). Use euro_format tables for these. US-format applies to 8AW (Argentina) and 93V (Brazil) sourced vehicles which are rare in GCC.
_notes.wau_vs_wa1: WAU = Audi passenger cars (A-class, sedans, wagons, coupes). WA1 = Audi SUVs/crossovers (Q3/Q5/Q7/Q8). This WMI-level distinction makes vehicle category identifiable before VDS decoding.
_notes.tru_note: TRU = Audi Hungaria (Győr). Hungary geographic zone = T. All Audi TT/TTS/TT RS and some R8 carry TRU — popular in UAE.
_notes.engine_code_note: The 3-letter engine stamp code (e.g., CZPB, CWGB, DNT) is NOT directly readable from the VIN. VDS pos8 identifies the engine FAMILY only. Precise variant requires OEM database lookup.
_notes.pr_codes_note: VW Group PR codes (3-character production codes on spare-wheel-well sticker) are the primary tool for full option/trim identification — far more granular than the VIN.

WAU.notes: A1-A8 sedans, hatchbacks, wagons, coupes from Ingolstadt and Neckarsulm

WA1.notes: Q3/Q5/Q7/Q8 from Ingolstadt and other German plants

TRU.notes: TT/TTS/TT RS, R8, some A3 variants from Győr; T = Hungary geographic zone

WUA.notes: RS models, RRS models, R8 production oversight

position_9._note: European-format VINs (WAU/WA1/TRU/WUA): pos9 is NOT a check digit. Often 'Z' or '0'. Do NOT run NHTSA check-digit validation. US-format VINs only: NHTSA formula applies.

position_11_plant.S: San José Chiapa, Mexico (Audi Mexico — Q5)

vds_format_detection._note: HOW TO DETECT FORMAT: If vin[3]+vin[4]+vin[5] == 'ZZZ' → use euro_format tables. Otherwise → use us_format tables. All WAU/WA1/WUA/TRU GCC vehicles will almost always be euro_format.

euro_format._note: European-format VDS: pos4-6 = ZZZ filler. Meaningful data only in pos7 and pos8.

position_7_model_line._note: Position 7 = model line code for European-format Audi VINs. This is the PRIMARY decode field for GCC Audis.

position_8_engine_family._note: Position 8 = engine family code for European-format. Most common UAE codes: B (2.0T EA888) and C (3.0T V6 EA839).
position_8_engine_family.A: EA211 TFSI (1.0T / 1.5T) — entry petrol turbo; Polo, Golf, A3 entry
position_8_engine_family.B: EA888 Gen.3 TFSI (2.0T) — most common A4/A5/Q5 engine in UAE
position_8_engine_family.C: EA839 MHEV (3.0T V6) — S-models, upper-spec A6/A7/Q7/Q8
position_8_engine_family.E: EA898 TDI (3.0L V6 diesel) — European diesel
position_8_engine_family.H: EA839 PHEV (TFSI 3.0L + electric motor) — Q7/Q8 PHEV
position_8_engine_family.K: EA855 (2.5L TFSI — RS3 / TT RS) — five-cylinder
position_8_engine_family.Z: Electric motor — e-tron/Q4 e-tron/e-tron GT BEV models

us_format._note: US-format VDS: all positions 4-8 carry attribute data. Applies to vehicles sold in North America. Rare in GCC but possible for grey imports.

position_6_restraint._note: Standard NHTSA restraint schema for US Audi VINs.
position_6_restraint.4: Manual belts + dual front + side airbags
position_6_restraint.5: Manual belts + dual front + side + curtain airbags
position_6_restraint.6: Full airbag suite (front + side + curtain + knee)
